skill_name: Conduct research on Japan's history of capitalism
workflow: Japan has had a long history of capitalism dating back to the early Meiji period from 1868 to 1912. During this period, the Japanese government invested heavily in new industrial enterprises and pushed for economic modernization, leading to the growth of large zaibatsu corporations. The zaibatsu further pushed for economic growth through increased investment in infrastructure, technology and foreign investments. This period was marked by increased foreign investment, marketization of the economy
